entries.german:
Johann von Swietlik verkauft dem Weclin von Zippendorf, dem Richter in Krumau und dem Caplan Mathias ebendaselbst einen halben Lahn in Swietlik sammt Zubehör um sieben Schock weniger zwei Prager Groschen.

Notum sit vniuersis tam presentibus quam futuris, quod ego Johannes filius quondam Welkonis de Swyetlyk vna cum omnibus fratribus et heredibus meis vniuersis presentibus et futuris sana mentis mee deliberacione et ex singulari assensu et consilio meorum amicorum vendidi et presentibus vendo medium laneum meum ibidem in Swyetlyk cum omnibus agris cultis et incultis area pratis pascuis siluis metis rubetis et vniuersis vtilitatibus ad eum quouis modo pertinentibus cum pleno dominio ac potestate, vnum talentum denariorum argenteorum annuatim censuantem, discretis et prouidis viris Weczlyno de Czypyn et iudici, qui protunc fuerit in Chrumpnaw, ac domino Mathie capellano protunc parrochie ibidem in Chrumpnaw eorumque successoribus futuris per eos perpetue habendum tenendum fruendum possidendum vendendum commutandum, seu pro qualibet eorum voluntate conuertendum, pro septem sexagenis grossorum Pragensium minus duobus grossis, quas me ab eis fateor percepisse pecuniis in paratis. De quo quidem medio laneo prescripto et eius attinenciis vniuersis ego Johannes prenominatus cum omnibus successoribus meis presentibus et futuris deinceps tenebor et tenebimur diuisim, videlicet in festo sancti Jeorgii medium talentum denariorum argenteorum et ia festo beati Galli tantumdem, annis singulis infallibiliter seu sine omni protrarccione perpetuis temporibus censuare, bernam deuoluciones ac alia iuia, prout aliorum incolarum ipsius ville consuetudo requirit, eciam porrigendo. Insuper promitto sine dolo ymmo sub puritate fidei et honoris, prelibata bona et eius omnes vtilitates prefatis emptoribus meis contra quemlibet hominem, cuiuscunque status aut condicionis extilerit, ipsa bona impetentem seu impetere volentem iure terre Bohemie pacificare atque libertare fatigiis meis propriis et impensis. Volens igitur hec omnia et singula per me et meos roborare et rata ac firma obseruare ad preces meas instantissimas sigillum nobilis et generosi domini Henrici de Rosemberch vna cum sigillis famosorum virorum Przybyconis de Zymunticz, protunc purgrauii in Chrumpnaw, et Mikulawssonis de Wyetrzn propter carenciam sigilli mei proprii in testimonium presentibus est appensum. Et quicunque hanc litteram de predictorum Weczlini domini Mathie ac judicis protunc in Chrumpnaw bona habuerit voluntate, cidem tamquam ipsis in omnibus superius tactis competit ius omnium premissorum. Datum et actum anno domini millesimo trecentesimo nonagesimo nono feria tercia post sancti Viti.

Siegel: Drei kleine, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel. a) In rothem Wachs; das bekannte Siegel des Heinrich v. R. b) In weissem Wachs; ein Helm mit dem Vordertheile eines Pferdes zur Zierde. - + S . Przibiconis . De . Zytmvntycz. c) In röthlichem Wachs; ein Helm mit einem Fässlein. - + S. Nicolai. D. Wysnie.
entries.english:
Hans von Swietlik sells Weclin von Zippendorf, the judge at Krumau and the chaplain Mathias there half a hide at Swietlik with its appurtenances for seven groups of sixty Prague groschen less two groschen.

Let it be known to all, present and future, that I, Hans de Swyetlyk, son of the late Welko, together with all my brothers and all my heirs, present and future, after sound deliberation and with the particular consent and advice of my friends, have sold and by these presents sell my half hide there in Swyetlyk, with all its cultivated and uncultivated fields, farmstead, meadows, pastures, woods, boundaries, thickets and all benefits belonging to it in any way, with full lordship and authority. It yields an annual rent of one talent of silver pennies. I sell it to the discreet and prudent men Weczlyn de Czypyn and the person who for the time being is judge in Chrumpnaw, and to Herr Mathias, for the time being chaplain of the parish there in Chrumpnaw, and their future successors, for them to have, hold, enjoy, possess, sell, exchange or dispose of perpetually as they wish, for seven groups of sixty Prague groschen less two groschen. I acknowledge that I have received this sum from them in ready money.

For the said half hide and all its appurtenances, I, the aforesaid Hans, and all my successors, present and future, shall henceforth be bound to pay rent in installments each year in perpetuity, without fail or delay: half a talent of silver pennies on the feast of St. George and the same amount on the feast of St. Gall. We shall also pay the berna, devolution dues and other dues as the custom of the other inhabitants of the village requires.

I further promise without deceit, indeed on my good faith and honor, to defend the aforesaid property and all its benefits for my said purchasers against any person, whatever his status or condition, who challenges or wishes to challenge their title to it, and to secure it for them under the law of the land of Bohemia, at my own effort and expense.

Wishing therefore to confirm all these things and each of them for myself and my people and to keep them valid and firm, I have, because I have no seal of my own, had the seal of the noble and high-born Herr Heinrich von Rosenberg attached to these presents, at my earnest request, together with the seals of the distinguished men Przybycon de Zymunticz, at that time Burggraf zu Chrumpnaw, and Mikulawsson de Wyetrzn, in testimony. Whoever holds this letter with the consent of the aforesaid Weczlyn, Herr Mathias and the person who is for the time being judge at Chrumpnaw shall have the same right to all the foregoing matters as they themselves have.

Done and given in the year of the Lord 1399, on the Tuesday after St. Vitus's day.

Seals: Three small seals hang from parchment strips. The first, in red wax, is the familiar seal of Heinrich von Rosenberg. The second, in white wax, shows a helmet with the forepart of a horse as its crest; its legend reads “S. Przibiconis de Zytmvntycz.” The third, in reddish wax, shows a helmet with a small barrel; its legend reads “S. Nicolai D. Wysnie.”
